notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market year 2026/27, a forecast (trader reference). Years differ.

Trade is grain sorghum (HS 100700), customs gross weight. USDA PSD gives production, use, trade and stocks of marketing years; the customs table is a calendar year. Sweet sorghum, broomcorn and forage sorghum are not in the code or are not told apart; sorghum flour and groats are not loaded.

Price: the only free price file the atlas loads, the World Bank Pink Sheet, has a grain sorghum series that stops in August 2020; it is published to that month and marked closed. No free series after it was found.
